title: Bumitama Agri says NEA has appointed expert panel members to assess firm’s links to haze - 联合早报
text:
Bumitama Agri: NEA appoints expert panel to assess haze links | Lianhe Zaobao 
 Singapore International China Business Opinion Lifestyle Entertainment Search Ulrica Lin Published / 18 Nov 2026 23:19 S M L XL Bumitama Agri says NEA has appointed expert panel members to assess firm’s links to haze
 AI-translated article with transliterated names. Read original Chinese article here. 
 NEA has appointed Kroll Associates as the assessor to evaluate whether the company is linked to transboundary haze from Indonesia, and TSMP Law Corporation as legal adviser to the assessor. （Photo: Neoh Kee Leng） Bumitama Agri said in a statement after the market closed on Wednesday (18 November) that it had received a letter dated 17 November from Singapore's National Environment Agency (NEA), naming the firms appointed to assess the company's links to transboundary haze from Indonesia. 
 The statement said NEA had appointed Kroll Associates as the assessor to evaluate whether the company was linked to transboundary haze, and TSMP Law Corporation as legal adviser to the assessor. 
 Bumitama Agri said it would bear the full cost of engaging the assessor and law firm. 
 NEA also appointed Davinder Singh Chambers to coordinate the work of the expert panel members. Bumitama Agri will pay NEA the related fees. 
 Bumitama Agri said, “The Company has accepted the terms of the Letter and will cooperate fully with NEA, the Assessor, and other parties in connection with the evaluation, in accordance with the prevailing laws and regulations.” 
 On 31 October, the Singapore government announced the members of an expert panel on transboundary haze investigations, comprising three investigation firms, three law firms and a legal adviser. They will help the authorities assess whether 10 named locally registered companies should be held liable for haze pollution. 
 For each named company, NEA will select an investigation firm and a law firm or legal adviser from the panel to form a review team to assess the company's operations, corporate links and supply chains. The companies under review will bear the costs. 
 Bumitama Agri shares closed at S$1.25 on Wednesday, down 2.34%. 
 This is an AI-translated article and some names may be transliterated. The original Chinese text remains authoritative, and SPH Media is not responsible for translation errors.
